Rationale.RP1_ImplementationReconstructability: The experiment was fully reconstructable from plan.md, CodeWalkthrough.md, and fv_demo.ipynb. The methodology was clearly described, all utility functions were documented, and pre-computed top heads were provided. No significant guesswork was required.
Rationale.RP2_EnvironmentReproducibility: Environment was reproducible using fv_environment.yml. GPT-J 6B model was available in shared cache. Baukit library installed successfully. Only minor cache permission issue required using alternative model location, but this was easily resolved.
Rationale.RP3_DeterminismAndStability: Results were stable with proper seed control via set_seed() function. Mean activations averaged over 100 trials. Evaluation showed consistent patterns matching paper claims. Variance in absolute accuracy explained by smaller test set (50 vs full dataset) and random sampling differences.
Rationale.RP4_DemoPresentation: The fv_demo.ipynb notebook was comprehensive and executable. It demonstrated all core experiments: function vector extraction, interventions in ICL/shuffled-label/zero-shot contexts, and natural text portability. All inputs and configurations were clearly specified. Demo outputs matched expected patterns from the paper.
